name: Document Loader HTML Processor - URL
description: Opt-in submodule of document_loader_html_processor. Fetches a URL and processes the returned HTML through the html_processor pipeline.
project_description: Opt-in submodule of document_loader_html_processor, disabled by default. It adds a single HTTP GET fetch step in front of the html_processor pipeline so a caller can hand the loader a URL instead of already-resolved HTML. Registered as a DocumentLoader plugin for document_loader_type:website (WebsiteUrlInput), it fetches the URL with Drupal's http_client (Guzzle), passes the raw response HTML to the html_processor pipeline (container extraction, regex stripping, ad removal, relative-URL rewriting, sanitizing), and auto-sets base_url from the fetched URL unless the caller supplies one. It is intentionally minimal — no Readability-style article extraction, no Markdown conversion, no retries; for those, use document_loader_webpage. Fetch guards: an http/https scheme allowlist, redirect-protocol pinning to http/https, a Content-Type check (HTML/XML media types), a 10 MB response cap enforced by a bounded streaming read (with a pre-flight Content-Length check), connect and overall request timeouts, and credential-safe error messages. Enable it only when you want the server to perform outbound HTTP requests to a caller-supplied URL; treat that URL as untrusted input and apply infrastructure-layer controls where callers are not fully trusted.
